about: Reviews show what app users feel. The S-1 shows what Anthropic tells investors. Quotes are verbatim, checked by script against the filing's text.
no_user_count: A text search of the S-1 finds no count of weekly, monthly or active users.

crosswalk.quote: We have also changed, and may in the future change, usage limits, rate limits, or model and product capabilities, which could adversely affect our reputation and the perceived value of our offerings
crosswalk.reading: Reviewers who say they pay describe the effect the filing warns about, and many say the allowance shrank after a model or app update.

crosswalk.bet: Free use has to pay back
crosswalk.quote: If the costs of supporting free users exceed the value we derive from their eventual conversion or other benefits such as network effects and word-of-mouth referrals
crosswalk.reading: Reviewers say the limit arrived before they could judge the product, and conversion depends on that first judgment.

crosswalk.quote: our current Consumer Terms of Service requires our users to be at least 18 years of age
crosswalk.reading: The filing gives the reason for the rule. The reviews add adults who say they were misflagged and people whose verification failed.

crosswalk.quote: we do not currently focus on developing video and image generation models, despite their commercial appeal
crosswalk.reading: Reviewers keep asking for what the filing says Anthropic isn't focused on, and some say the gap wasn't clear before they paid.

crosswalk.quote: If we fail to maintain high-quality customer support, our ability to retain and expand customers could suffer
crosswalk.reading: Reviewers describe billing and account problems that end at a bot or a help-centre link.

crosswalk.quote: We have in the past discovered, and may in the future discover, errors, vulnerabilities, or other defects, such as hallucinations, in our models, platform, and applications only after deployment
crosswalk.reading: The same topic draws both praise and complaints in the reviews, so accuracy is split by task and reader.

crosswalk.bet: Claude Code users spend the most
crosswalk.quote: the top 5% of Claude Enterprise users who used Claude Code spent approximately 20 times that amount
crosswalk.reading: The filing's heaviest spenders use Claude Code, and app reviewers praise coding too. Their complaints include sessions that stop at the limit with the job unfinished.

crosswalk.quote: in March 2026, we experienced a service outage and periods of degraded performance
crosswalk.reading: The filing's example predates this window. Weekly complaints here have eased since August but haven't stopped.
